overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating VLMs' responses to ambiguous visual questions. The main NLG task is Visual Question Answering. The evaluation uses both automatic classification (via LLM-as-judge) and human evaluation with the same three-category framework (Explicit/Implicit/High Risk). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of redundant descriptions.
